invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must not allow a different client to redeem a subject_token minted for another client to obtain effective permissions beyond BrokerPolicy for that client.

params.name: i5_exchange_clientA
params.description: Client A for cross-client token exchange confusion test

params.name: i5_exchange_clientB
params.description: Client B for cross-client token exchange confusion test

oracle_checks.violation_description: Client B successfully exchanged a subject_token minted under a different client context, indicating missing client-binding/authorization binding in token exchange (I5).

description: Obtain a subject_token for a resource, then tighten application policy by disabling token exchange and attempt to exchange again for the same resource to see if stale authorization is honored.
invariant_hypothesis: I5: After BrokerPolicy is tightened (token exchange disabled), subsequent token exchange must be rejected even if the subject_token was minted earlier; effective permissions must not exceed current BrokerPolicy.

params.name: i5_exchange_policy_tighten_app
params.description: App for I5 policy tighten then exchange test

oracle_checks.violation_description: Token exchange succeeded even after the application disabled token exchange, indicating stale policy enforcement and potential over-grant beyond BrokerPolicy (I5).

description: Attempt to use RFC8693 token exchange to mint a token for a protected API resource while authenticating the exchange request as a different client than the one that obtained the original subject_token. Secure behavior: Logto must bind effective permissions to both upstream intent (subject_token) and broker policy (client/app), rejecting cross-client exchange or not minting an active token for the requested resource.
invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must not allow a subject_token minted under one client context to be used by a different client to obtain an active token for a protected resource (resource indicator), otherwise EffectivePerms(session) can exceed UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy.

params.name: i5_appA_token_exchange_source
params.description: Source client for subject_token minting

params.name: i5_appB_token_exchange_target
params.description: Target client attempting to exchange someone else's subject_token

oracle_checks.violation_description: Sanity: apps created and Alice can login to appA.
